instruction: Review the committed change benchmark-base..HEAD without modifying or staging files. framing.decode(hex_data) receives hexadecimal encoded frames with a four-byte unsigned big-endian payload byte length followed by exactly that many UTF-8 bytes. Return the decoded string. Reject a missing header, truncated payload, or trailing bytes with ValueError. Hex encoding and payload UTF-8 are valid; length is always network/big-endian order. Report only actionable defects introduced by the candidate; do not report style preferences.
